notes: Top street printed only '... STREET' in the strip; it continues east of Quebec as W. LIBERTY ST., so named West Liberty Street. The N-S street at x~4935 north of Warsaw is printed only 'AVENUE' (name not on this plate) -> '?'; south of Warsaw it is the same line, labelled BEECH ST. near y 5200, so Beech Street used from Warsaw south. Stub at x 5296 entering from the top edge has an unreadable cut label -> '?'. Iliff Avenue is offset at Warsaw: north part centre x~3674, south part x~3520 (two T's). Warsaw Avenue = the E-W street at y~1790 (labelled WARSAW on its south-east leg beyond x 5500). At (5265,1778) an unnamed street forks NE from Warsaw to the junction with Quebec (printed QUEBEC only) and an unnamed street running east at (5555,1700). The diagonal street through (4982,3983) and (5395,3837) is printed only 'AVENUE' (at x~6400); named Glenway Avenue from the plate description; it bends at x~4435 and continues west at y~4185 (house numbers continuous; printed ST. LAWRENCE far west at x~1300, outside strip). Academy Avenue is offset at Glenway: north part x~4485, south part x~4358. Seton: printed SETON near y 5450 and 'AVENUE' north of Vincent; treated as one street Seton Avenue. Hamilton Ave. (VACATED) at x~5560 near the bottom not picked. Bottom street (West 8th Street) is cut by the plate edge; centre estimated y~5875. Diagonal grey/orange band from (4600,5830) to (5640,5400) with a 30in sewer is a boundary band, not a street. Spaced lettering (CONRAD HARRIS, C. HARRIS, WM J. ANSHUTZ, PLEASANT VIEW SUB., HOPPE...) is subdivision/estate names.
